tools.name: x402_seller_check
tools.description: x402 seller revenue and wash check (Base USDC) ($0.02 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). For any Base address that receives payments (an x402/MPP seller payTo, a merchant, a treasury): weekly USDC inflow curve for 1-3 weeks with distinct payers and new payers per week, USDC net of refunds/round trips

tools.name: wallet_flows
tools.description: Wallet USDC flows and counterparties (Base) ($0.01 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). USDC in/out for any Base wallet over the last 1-14 days: totals, net flow, transfer counts, and the top 10 counterparties each way (who funds it, who it pays). Related-wallet discovery from public chain data, no lab

tools.name: wallet_snapshot
tools.description: Base wallet snapshot: ETH, USDC, nonce, contract check ($0.003 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). One call: ETH balance, USDC balance, transaction count (nonce), whether the address is a contract or an EIP-7702 delegated EOA, on Base mainnet. HTTP POST https://mpp-walletintel.fmf-x402.workers.dev/wal

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "x402_seller_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_seller_check, wallet_snapshot · Private data: x402_seller_check, wallet_flows, wallet_snapshot · Public sink: x402_seller_check, wallet_flows, wallet_snapshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_seller_check, wallet_snapshot · Private data: x402_seller_check, wallet_flows, wallet_snapshot · Public sink: x402_seller_check, wallet_flows, wallet_snapshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
